segments.name: Energy and Sustainability Solutions
segments.description: One of Honeywell's four reportable business segments in 2025; the Advanced Materials business was spun off from it in October 2025.

revenueModel.text: Honeywell sells products, software and services to OEMs, airlines, aircraft operators, industrial customers and the U.S. government, and also provides spare parts, repair, overhaul and maintenance services.
revenueModel.evidence: Aerospace Technologies also provides spare parts, repair, overhaul, and maintenance services (principally to aircraft operators), and sells licenses or intellectual property to other parties.

changes.text: In 2025, Honeywell completed the spin-off of its Advanced Materials business into Solstice Advanced Materials, previously part of Energy and Sustainability Solutions.
changes.evidence: On October 30, 2025, we completed the spin-off of our Advanced Materials (AM) business into an independent, publicly traded company named Solstice Advanced Materials, Inc. (Solstice).

changes.text: In 2025, Honeywell announced a planned realignment effective in the first quarter of 2026 creating a new Process Automation and Technology segment.
changes.evidence: In October 2025, the Company announced a planned realignment, expected to be effective in the first quarter of 2026, of its business units comprising its Industrial Automation and Energy and Sustainability Solutions reportable business segments to form a new reportable business segment, Process Automation and Technology, and result in a new composition of its Industrial Automation reportable business segment.

changes.text: In 2025, Honeywell announced its intention to separate from Honeywell Aerospace into independent public companies, expected in the third quarter of 2026.
changes.evidence: On February 6, 2025, we announced our plans to separate Honeywell from Honeywell Aerospace, into two independent U.S. public companies.
